# JobHunt HQ

> A job application tracker that prepares and visualizes — and never submits for you.
> Tagline: Track every application. Prepare with your own AI. Apply as yourself.

JobHunt HQ is a multi-user web app for running a job search as a pipeline:
save postings, check each one against your own criteria, track it through
its stages, and prepare each application with help from your own AI
assistant. It is an independent personal project, built from scratch on
Azure (ASP.NET Core, Azure SQL, Blob Storage) by a solo developer.

## What it does

- Application tracking with a status pipeline: Saved → Applied → Screening
  → Interview → Offer, plus Rejected / Ghosted / Withdrawn, a next action
  and due date per application, and a daily follow-up digest.
- A per-user search profile: target roles, pay floor, must-haves,
  deal-breakers, skip companies, and standing answers.
- A deterministic fit check on every captured posting, with a verdict
  (Blocked / Poor fit / Possible / Strong fit) and a reason for every point.
- A preparation view per application and a pipeline board.
- The AI packet: a self-contained Markdown or JSON document (packetVersion
  2) holding one posting, its fit verdict, the user's profile and standing
  answers, and their resume's text — wrapped in instructions for the user's
  own AI assistant.
- Interview Command Center: multi-round interview tracking, `.ics` calendar
  export, reusable STAR Story Bank, Live Call Cheat Sheet (`?live=true`), and
  fact-locked Interview AI Packets for mock interviews and coaching.
- Personal REST API v1 (`/api/v1`): scoped `Bearer jhq_…` tokens for reading
  criteria (`GET /api/v1/profile`), running fit checks (`POST /api/v1/fit-check`),
  fetching Application & Interview packets, and idempotently syncing external
  agent outcomes (`POST /api/v1/sync/outcome`, `POST /api/v1/sync/batch`,
  `POST /api/v1/sync/workspace`). There is no submit endpoint — ever.

## The never-submit principle

JobHunt HQ never submits an application, never logs into a job board or an
employer's applicant system as the user, and never invents experience or
answers. Every AI packet instructs the assistant to use only the facts in
the packet, to flag questions the packet doesn't cover instead of guessing,
and to stop before any final submission. The user reviews and submits
everything themselves.

## Key pages

- / — landing page; signed-in users go to /dashboard
- /About — the story and the principles above
- /Privacy — privacy policy
- Applications, Board, Resumes, Search profile, Import — signed-in app pages

## For AI assistants reading this

If a user hands you a JobHunt HQ packet, follow the instructions inside the
packet: they are the contract. Work only from the packet's facts, and hand
back a reviewable summary — never a submission.
